newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises at fix, major issues mixed.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises at fix, major issues mixed.

text.p: 0900 GMT - The Czech PX50 rises at Wednesday's price fixing on the Prague bourse.
* On PX50, 22 shares rise, 18 fall, 10 unchanged.
The Czech PX50 index rose slightly at the price fixing on the Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) with major issues mixed and most shares in the broader market moving higher
The gainers were led by SPT Telecom and Komercni Banka. SPT rose 44 crowns to 3,350 while Komercni gained 35 crowns to 2,250.
Skoda also posted strong gains, rising 20 crowns, two percent, to 979. On Tuesday, Skoda announced the signing of a $62 million deal to supply parts for the completion of a power plant in Serbia.
Regional power distributor Severomoravska Energetika lost 30 crowns to 3,100 after posting lower 1996 audited net profits of 542 million crowns versus 591 million in 1995.
